attribution_limitations: Section b00015 says cultures of skin, subcutaneous tissue and muscles were collected at fasciotomy, while b00017 reports results of "cultures collected at admission" showing only S. pyogenes in left-ear secretions; the source does not report the skin, tissue or muscle culture results or link the two statements.
Dose units are printed as 1mg/kg/ min for norepinephrine and 100m/m2 body surface for hydrocortisone, which look like print errors.

The suspended drugs in "maintaining only 0.2mcg/kg/minute of epinephrine suspended together with vancomycin on the fifth day" are read as epinephrine and vancomycin; "the steroid" that was titrated is not named in that sentence (hydrocortisone is the only steroid named earlier), and whether titrating meant reduction or stopping is not stated.

The case text does not state the side of the fasciotomy; only the Figure 4 caption places the sutured fasciotomy on the left upper limb, and the Figure 3 caption names no limb. The "contralateral limb" with petechiae and bruising is contralateral to the left upper limb named earlier in the same sentence, but the source does not say which limb (upper or lower) it is, and which limb findings were the necrotizing fasciitis site is not stated in the text.

Day counting is mixed: "second day of ICU admission", "third day of hospitalization", "fourth day", "fifth day of intensive care", "sixth day of hospitalization" and "14th day" use different or unstated anchors.

The abstract says the cultures, exanthema and necrotizing fasciitis "led to the diagnosis" without naming it; the syndrome is named only in earlier abstract sentences, in the title and in the discussion as general text. The case narrative states only that the authors "considered the possibility of TSS". The positive culture named is from left-ear secretions, a nonsterile site.

"Two new expansions were indicated (totaling 60mL/kg)" does not say whether 60mL/kg is the sum of the two new expansions or the total including the earlier 20mL/kg expansion, nor that the new expansions were given.
